criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold register on every frame, real measured reliefs on 6 to 8 with correct counts; 1 and 9 strongest. The dog is a smooth SDF figurine, slide 5 a primitive monitor with unlabelled bars, slide 8 a slab on a rail with a dead lower band, slide 3 labels on plates with the car out of frame, 6 and 7 two waffle grids.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Three continuity devices work, one key, one grade; 6 to 8 leave the street world and 5 is a fourth setting, so two decks joined at 6.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, sources primary, quotes verbatim, the 2019 absence stated. The caption's 'Object detection software will find the dogs' infers a little past c3; slide 3 makes a per-clip check per-dog.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and when are clear; why, which areas, who decided and what a reader can do are missing; the appearance stake is never cashed out on a slide.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Legible cover, modest slide 2, real turn at 4 then away; 5 restates 3; 6 and 7 both carry 32 areas; the close is soft.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, a good closing question; flat caption opener and generic hooks on 5 and 9; no regional texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New subject and world against nos. 62 to 65; the lastLight stage again and counted squares echo nos. 63 and 64.

ranked_defects.fix: Make the hook the open question about the stray versus owned call; name ACS as recipient after December.
Fold the 2019 mould and cast into slide 6.

ranked_defects.defect: The appearance stake is never stated.
ranked_defects.fix: State that the release gives no measure of how often an appearance call is right.
Print the four c5 check names as DOM row labels.

ranked_defects.defect: Hook names a method, not a consequence.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Slab on a rail reads as a progress bar, lower 40 percent dead.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop tight so the block fills a third of the frame height with its long cast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive monitor in a near void, unlabelled bars.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Reviewer's shoulder silhouette, DOM labels from c5.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Labels on plates, car and phone out of frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Car rear quarter and lit lens in the bottom right; labels without plates.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Regular grid reads as a waffle.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Deeper street grooves, irregular plug positions.
Closer, lower camera with clamp jaws and glass edge large.
